items.title: Uber Technologies (UBER), Why Is It Back In The Spotlight?
items.summary: Uber Technologies (UBER) is back under the legal spotlight after a retired California judge ordered the company to pay US$40 million in a wrongful death case tied to its ride hailing service. Uber Technologies shares trade at US$70.87 and have drifted lower in recent months, with the 30 day share price return down 5.08% and the year to date share price return down 14.47%. items.title: Costco Ramps Up Same-Day Delivery, Expanding Uber, DoorDash Partnerships
items.summary: Costco is expanding its fast delivery network as it works to grow sales in new ways.  Earlier this week Uber said it would expand its partnership with Costco to deliver products in 47 U.S. states, up from 17 states.  On Thursday DoorDash said it would also start delivering Costco products in the U.S. from all U.S. locations.
